no_founder_ruling_is_invented_here: This packet records questions and recommendations. It signs nothing, and no disposition in it has been defaulted or completed by the agent.

A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.item: La Quinta: three rows, two premises, crossed routes
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.evidence: 'la quinta inn and suites by wyndham louisville northeast old henry' (13825 Terra View Trl, 40245) and 'la quinta inn and suites louisville east' (13825 Terra View Trail, 40245) share one street address with two different telephones. Their official_urls are crossed: the first points at the brand's 'louisville-east' page, which serves 1501 Alliant Avenue, Jeffersontown 40299 -- the premises of a THIRD row, 'la quinta inn and suites louisville', which this market already publishes off that same page. A Firecrawl read of that page today re-derived the published record's facts exactly.
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.recommendation: Confirm the published row keeps the Alliant Avenue page. Rule whether the two Terra View rows are one premises or two, then rebind the survivor's route.
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.census_effect: possible retirement of one duplicate row (MOVE, never delete)
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.authority_effect: none to the published record; it is confirmed correct
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.routing_effect: two unresolved rows carry a route to the wrong building
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.reversibility: fully reversible; nothing published depends on it

A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.item: Homewood Suites Louisville East: two rows, one brand property
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.evidence: The census carries 'homewood suites by hilton louisville east' (10245 Linn Station Rd, Louisville 40223) and 'homewood suites louisville east' (9401 Hurstbourne Trace, Lyndon 40222). Hilton's own published roster contains exactly ONE Homewood Suites Louisville East (sdfeahw) plus a separate Homewood Suites Louisville Airport (sdfaihw). Both rows resolve to the single sdfeahw property, so at most one of them can hold that route.
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.recommendation: Rule which row is the Homewood Suites Louisville East and whether the other is a duplicate, the airport property, or a stale address.
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.census_effect: possible retirement or re-address of one row
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.routing_effect: blocks a free route that is otherwise available

A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.item: Six Choice identities share ONE Shepherdsville Sleep Inn URL
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.evidence: 'comfort inn', 'comfort inn and suites', 'country inn and suites louisville east ky', 'econo lodge airport', 'quality inn and suites' and 'sleep inn louisville' all carry the single official_url choicehotels.com/kentucky/shepherdsville/sleep-inn-hotels. Five of the six are not even Sleep Inns. The partition already refuses this URL as non-property-level, so no policy rests on it.
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.recommendation: Strip the shared URL from all six rows so a future lane cannot mistake it for a property route, then re-route each identity individually.
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.authority_effect: none; nothing published rests on this URL
A_identity_alias_successor_same_campus.routing_effect: six rows carry a route to a building that is not theirs

B_geography.item: Roster properties in outlying towns the census does not hold
B_geography.evidence: Hilton's Louisville-coded roster includes Spark La Grange, Hampton Cave City, Spark Cave City and Hampton Simpsonville; Marriott's includes Elizabethtown, Bardstown, Shelbyville, Shepherdsville and Madison. These carry the Louisville airport code but sit outside the corridors this market publishes.
B_geography.recommendation: Confirm the market boundary excludes them, or admit them deliberately.

C_closure_conversion_non_lodging.item: 18 rows absent from their own brand's current roster
C_closure_conversion_non_lodging.evidence: For each of these the brand's OWN published sitemap served us and does not list the property: days inn by wyndham clarksville, days inn central university and expo center, fairfield inn and suites by marriott clarksville, fairfield inn and suites by marriott louisville north, hampton inn jeffersonville louisville north, hampton inn sellersburg, hawthorn suites by wyndham louisville jeffersontown, home2 suites by hilton jeffersonville, home2 suites by hilton louisville northeast, howard johnson by wyndham louisville airport, la quinta inn and suites by wyndham louisville airport expo, microtel inn and suites by wyndham louisville airport, ramada plaza louisville hotel and conference center, super 8 by wyndham clarksville, super 8 by wyndham louisville southwest, super 8 by wyndham new albany, tru by hilton jeffersonville louisville north, tru by hilton louisville downtown
C_closure_conversion_non_lodging.asserts_no_closure: A property ABSENT from a brand's published roster is a statement about the BRAND ROSTER, not proof that a building closed or stopped taking guests. Every absence here is routed to a founder identity question, never to a closure ruling.
C_closure_conversion_non_lodging.recommendation: Treat each as an identity question -- renamed, rebranded, sold out of the brand, or closed -- and resolve before spending any paid lane on a route for it.
C_closure_conversion_non_lodging.authority_effect: none; none of these is published
C_closure_conversion_non_lodging.routing_effect: explains why the free lane cannot route them

D_policy_ambiguity_reader_exception.item: One published record rests on a bare label with no other pet fact
D_policy_ambiguity_reader_exception.evidence: Of 46 published pet-friendly records, 45 carry either prose evidence or a terse label ALONGSIDE substantive fee, weight, count or species facts drawn from the same document. One -- motel 6 louisville airport fair expo -- carries the single quote 'Pets Allowed' and no other pet fact. It is first-party, digest-backed and founder-approved, and nothing contradicts it; it is simply the thinnest record in the market.
D_policy_ambiguity_reader_exception.recommendation: Re-capture on the next lane that reaches motel6.com, or accept it explicitly as thin.

D_policy_ambiguity_reader_exception.item: Three new clean rows state a fee without naming its period
D_policy_ambiguity_reader_exception.evidence: 21c Museum Hotel ('The pet fee is $40'), Hotel Bourre Bonne ('$75 per pet fee applied at check-in'), and the tiered stay fees at Hawthorn Suites and Staybridge Suites. In each case the unstated qualifier is recorded in withheld_facts_and_reasons rather than defaulted.
D_policy_ambiguity_reader_exception.recommendation: Publish with the qualifier withheld, or hold for a clarifying capture.

E_evidence_conflict.item: 7 rows still rest on a retired build's founder-approved policy with no capture in the current corpus
E_evidence_conflict.evidence: The observation store lists 19 identities restated from PTF-LOUISVILLE-FOUNDING-AUTHORITY-APPLICATION-001A without a capture. This order captured 12 of them publication-grade. The remainder are: econo lodge downtown, omni louisville hotel, red roof inn, red roof inn louisville expo airport, rivue tower, studio 6 louisville airport expo center, the inn at woodhaven
E_evidence_conflict.recommendation: Do not carry a retired build's approval forward as evidence; re-capture or leave unresolved.
